status: Proposed next block only, not executed as a twenty-test campaign.
positive_controls: All six independently checked sparse matrices remain pinned.
Ratios to printed determinants are1,1,-1,-1,1 for nonzero fixtures; preserve both unresolved mismatches.
A6 exact rational rank413 and explicit right-null residual remain accepted computational evidence.
Source tuple, basis, pairing, normalization and matrix certificates are checked separately.

mutations.name: coefficient_order
mutations.mutation: Swap two of the ten coefficient slots.
mutations.required_outcome: Reject source binding even if an accidentally symmetric fixture has the same determinant.

mutations.name: driver_label_collision
mutations.mutation: Apply m=2m only to fixture(A.2), confusing it with driver section A.2.
mutations.required_outcome: Reject inconsistent normalization across fixtures.

mutations.name: driver_typo
mutations.mutation: Silently assign c2L4p when executing the printed c2L4 assignment.
mutations.required_outcome: Require a disclosed repair or explicit fixture-tuple assignment.

mutations.name: target_pairing
mutations.mutation: Replace sp pairings with target coordinates without the Gram factor.
mutations.required_outcome: Reject determinant normalization; confirm target Gram factor2^164*3^28.

mutations.name: selfdual_half
mutations.mutation: Omit the1/2 in cleavep.
mutations.required_outcome: Detect changed block Gram and matrix normalization.

mutations.name: global_sign_blindness
mutations.mutation: Negate the entire448 matrix.
mutations.required_outcome: Determinants remain equal; operator-level signed witness must distinguish it.

mutations.name: transpose_blindness
mutations.mutation: Transpose the full matrix while preserving determinant.
mutations.required_outcome: Reject input/output type and row/column binding mismatch.

mutations.name: fixture_specific_sign
mutations.mutation: Negate one row only for fixtures3 and4 to force printed agreement.
mutations.required_outcome: Reject fixture-dependent basis convention without a source-derived reason.

mutations.name: fixed_basis_orientation
mutations.mutation: Permute a fixed pair of basis vectors in every fixture.
mutations.required_outcome: Verify a common determinant sign change across every nonzero fixture.

mutations.name: contraction_order
mutations.mutation: Reverse the order of vector contractions for a two-form.
mutations.required_outcome: Primitive orientation witness must detect the sign difference.

mutations.name: raise_wedge_order
mutations.mutation: Move the left inserted vector from the printed wedge position.
mutations.required_outcome: Degree-sensitive sign checks must reject the altered operator.

mutations.name: projection_factor
mutations.mutation: Change one projY denominator or sign.
mutations.required_outcome: Exact idempotence, wedge/contraction kernels and matrix entries must expose it.

mutations.name: summand_pairing
mutations.mutation: Reorder Y4+ starred terms independently of their paired unstarred terms.
mutations.required_outcome: Reject changed paired basis vectors and Gram/source-binding failures.

mutations.name: bad_prime
mutations.mutation: Use primes2,3,5,7 as the sole fixture discriminator.
mutations.required_outcome: Reject a non-discriminating certificate; all reported nonzero determinant residues vanish there.

mutations.name: modular_rank_loss
mutations.mutation: Infer rational singularity from zero determinant modulo101.
mutations.required_outcome: Reject using invertible rational diag(101,1) as a negative control.

mutations.name: null_entry_mutation
mutations.mutation: Change an entry intersecting the explicit A6 right-null witness.
mutations.required_outcome: Exact residual verifier rejects the now-invalid witness.

mutations.name: rank_dimension
mutations.mutation: Treat a right-null vector in the row-input matrix as a geometric source-kernel vector.
mutations.required_outcome: Require transpose/dual interpretation and complete basis mapping.

mutations.name: CRT_without_bound
mutations.mutation: Promote agreement modulo a finite product to exact determinant equality without a size bound.
mutations.required_outcome: Reject unless a certified bound uniquely identifies the integer determinant.

mutations.name: covector_samples
mutations.mutation: Infer all-covector ellipticity from e1,e2,e1+e2 tests.
mutations.required_outcome: Require an equivariance/homogeneity bridge; finite samples alone are insufficient.

mutations.name: source_matrix_binding
mutations.mutation: Present a determinant certificate for an altered matrix with the same dimensions.
mutations.required_outcome: Verify exact matrix digest and source-derived entry bindings before accepting arithmetic.

prerequisite: All60 initial reviews complete; every GO gets first block before renewal
